keyEvents.text: Kevin O'Toole (New York City FC) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Alexis Sánchez (CF Montréal) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Dani Pereira (CF Montréal) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! New York City FC 1, CF Montréal 0. Andrés Perea (New York City FC) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Nicolás Fernández Mercau.
Substitution, New York City FC. Nico Cavallo replaces Kevin O'Toole.
Second Half begins New York City FC 1, CF Montréal 0.
Olger Escobar (CF Montréal) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Jonathan Shore (New York City FC) is shown the yellow card for handball.
Talles Magno (New York City FC) is shown the yellow card.
Substitution, New York City FC. Luighi replaces Talles Magno.
Substitution, New York City FC. Raul Gustavo replaces Jonathan Shore.
Substitution, New York City FC. Hannes Wolf replaces Bénie Traoré.
Substitution, New York City FC. Keaton Parks replaces Andrés Perea.
Viktor Radojević (CF Montréal) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Delay in match because of an injury Agustín Ojeda (New York City FC).
Substitution, CF Montréal. Fabian Herbers replaces Olger Escobar.
Substitution, CF Montréal. Luca Petrasso replaces Dawid Bugaj.
Substitution, CF Montréal. Matty Longstaff replaces Samuel Piette.
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, CF Montréal. Daniel Ríos replaces Hennadii Synchuk.
Delay in match because of an injury Keaton Parks (New York City FC).
Fabian Herbers (CF Montréal) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Goal! New York City FC 1, CF Montréal 1. Daniel Ríos (CF Montréal) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the top left corner.
Second Half ends, New York City FC 1, CF Montréal 1.
